title: Supertext plugin version report, v1
description: Body of POST /api/v1/report. Sent by a Supertext plugin when its settings are saved and when its own, the system's or the runtime's version changed. See docs/DEVELOPER.md → Report protocol.

event.description: Why the report is sent: installed, settings_saved, upgraded (plugin, system or runtime version changed since the last report) or check (sent by a command or test). Other values are stored as given.

site_url.description: Base URL of the installation (the site or back end the plugin runs in). It identifies the installation; the center normalizes it (see site-url-vectors.json).

name.description: The plugin's GitHub repository name, e.g. Typo3-Supertext-Translation.

version.description: The version from the plugin's official version source (see plugin-conventions → Releases).

system.description: The host system: CMS, PIM, shop or application.

runtime.description: The language runtime the plugin runs on, e.g. PHP 8.3.12, Node.js 22.11.0, Python 3.12.7, .NET 9.0.0, Java 21.0.4.

sdk_version.description: Version of the bundled Supertext SDK, if any.

api_key_configured.description: Whether a Supertext API key is set. Never the key itself.
